title: Call for Visiting Research Fellows
institution: Blavatnik Interdisciplinary Cyber Research Center (ICRC), Tel Aviv University
about: Tel Aviv University's Blavatnik Interdisciplinary Cyber Research Center offers 2027-2028 visiting research fellowships of about 4 to 9 months (October 2027 to June 2028) for scholars and PhD candidates in cybersecurity, AI and related fields. Fellows arrange their own funding.
requirements: Scholars and PhD candidates in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and related fields; any scientific discipline welcome
Non-stipendiary: fellows arrange their own funding (the Center helps with external funding applications)
One PDF under 2 MB: research proposal, comprehensive CV, recommendation letter

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI II
